subject: I can't install package shiny on RStudio-server

messages.author: 2a80a91e4ebbbcf7
messages.subject: I can't install package shiny on RStudio-server
parts:
Hi, I'm a newbie.

I installed Rstudio-Server, and R version 3.2.3  on CentOS 6.6.

I tried install package Shiny using command 
   sudo su - \
-c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='https://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

but, result was like this,
